jobs.title: Staff Product Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

Our mission is to reinvent the way people learn, starting with language.

Learning a language can change a life by opening doors to new cultures, careers, and communities. Two billion people around the world are actively trying to learn a language, but the best way to learn (one-on-one tutoring) is hard to access at scale and hasn’t been meaningfully improved in decades. Speak is building a human-level, AI-powered tutor in your pocket: a conversation-first experience that lets learners actually speak, get instant feedback, and progress through carefully designed lessons. The result is a complete path from beginner to confident speaker across multiple languages.

Speak first launched in South Korea in 2019, where Speak has now become the number one language learning app, and we now serve learners across many markets and 15+ languages. Speak is one of the world’s leading AI companies, with over $150m raised in venture investment from OpenAI, Accel, Founders Fund, Khosla Ventures, and more, with a distributed team across San Francisco, Seoul, Tokyo, Taipei, and Ljubljana.

About this role

Speak is seeking an experienced Product Designer to join our growing team!

This is a unique opportunity to help shape the future of language learning. This IC role will help designing innovative AI-driven conversational experiences that redefine how language is taught and learned. Partnering closely with our CEO, CTO, and cross-functional teams, you’ll play a key role in developing product strategy, creating new interactions, and evolving our core product experience.

In this high-impact position, you’ll have the chance to design novel experiences across voice, audio, and video interactions, putting your stamp on features and product direction for an app that is already beloved by users.

What you’ll be doing

  • Work with teams across product, design, and engineering to prioritize and spec out new features to build

  • Work directly with engineering to ensure a feature gets built, balancing your vision, technical feasibility, and user value

  • Design new features all the way from concept to finalized pixels

  • Design the UX and UI of new features across platforms, developing and implementing a consistent design language

  • Take focused ownership of designing our AI tutoring product, rethinking the way our users learn language from the ground up

  • Help support miscellaneous design work across the company as needed

What we’re looking for?

  • 6+ years of experience as a Product Designer in consumer-facing products.

  • Extensive experience leading design projects for web and mobile products.

  • Experience working on a small design team and "doing it all"

  • You enjoy going deep on both UX and UI work

  • You're a clear communicator and enjoy working closely with partners across teams, particularly in engineering

  • You've invested in your craft and have experience with prototyping, micro-interactions, utilizing motion, and creating design palettes

  • An ideal candidate will additionally have experience designing a consumer/content-forward app, audio and speaking experiences, as well as have a personal interest in language learning

Office

  • San Francisco, CA

Why work at Speak

  1. Join a fantastic, tight-knit team at the right time: we're growing very quickly, we've most recently raised our Series C from some of the top investors in the valley, and we've achieved product-market fit in our initial markets. You'd join at a magical time when a single person could significantly change the course of the company.

  2. Do your life's work with people you’ll love working with: we care strongly about our craft and want every person at Speak to feel like they're growing every day. We believe in the idea that working with people you both enjoy and have respect for makes everything better. We hire thoughtfully and only work with people we admire deeply.

  3. Global in nature: We're live in over 40 countries and launching in a number of new markets soon. We have dedicated offices in San Francisco, Ljubljana, Seoul, and Tokyo, and you’ll have the opportunity to talk to users in each of these regions on a regular basis as well as travel.

  4. Impact people's lives in a major way: Learning a language is one of the single most life-changing skills one can learn, and right now 99% of people never achieve their goal because the process is broken. We’re helping millions of people achieve their goals and improve their lives.

Speak does not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

As an AI Product Engineer at Speak, you'll play a pivotal role in developing the future of language learning and creating the most effective path to language fluency. Your primary responsibility will be developing innovative product experiences powered by Language Learning Models (LLMs) and deploying them to millions of users.

Your tasks will span the full stack and beyond, from evaluating models and testing prompts to developing and iterating on various product features such as our conversational onboarding and lesson experiences, grammatical assessment and feedback, and personalized lessons.

We're constantly pushing the boundaries of what LLMs can do to provide an exceptional and unparalleled language learning experience to users in over 30 countries worldwide.

What you'll be doing

  • Developing and deploying LLM-powered language learning products across the full stack, as well as enhancing the quality and performance of existing AI-powered features within Speak

  • Collaborating cross-functionally with other Engineering teams, Applied ML, Product, Design, and Content

  • Refining our process for building LLM apps, including best practices for prompting, experimentation/evaluation, LLM Ops, measuring quality and performance, etc.

  • Scaling existing product features to many more users and languages

What we're looking for

  • 3-5+ years of experience in full stack/backend, product-focused software engineering

    • Proficiency in React/Node/Typescript and Python

  • You have real-world experience developing and deploying LLM apps and a strong understanding, gained through experience, of what works and what doesn't

  • A keen intuition for improving performance and output quality of LLM systems

  • Experience with LLM Ops and tools (e.g., vector databases, RAG, prompt ops)

  • Strong product intuition — the ability to think broadly and cross-functionally about innovative LLM-powered capabilities and product experiences

  • Ability to work independently and build at a high velocity

Office

  • San Francisco, CA

We are looking for an experienced Machine Learning Engineer to join our team and help develop cutting-edge speech recognition models that help teach language fluency. In this role you will take ownership of the end-to-end modeling pipeline, from training and experimentation to deployment and monitoring. You will also work closely with Product teams to design innovative learning experiences and measure the efficacy of production models as they affect our end users. We are a small, dynamic team where you will contribute as a developer and thought partner on team projects like ASR, assessment, pronunciation, content personalization, and much more. This is an incredibly exciting time to join an ML team designing a personalized learning experience that will revolutionize language learning for millions of learners worldwide — come join us!

What you'll be doing

  • Training and deploying ASR models end-to-end, including monitoring, performance tracking, and retraining

  • Improving the pronunciation model that provides precise feedback, and make it more central to our learning app

  • Creating metrics to measure ASR performance across tasks and languages

  • Expanding our ASR systems to new languages and markets

  • Building and maintaining data infrastructure such as training/evaluation datasets and labeling pipelines

What we're looking for

  • Extensive experience training large models on GPUs and deploying custom deep learning models

  • Proficiency in Python and common Deep Learning frameworks like PyTorch

  • Demonstrated experience owning ML pipelines end to end, from POC to production

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex ML concepts to non-technical stakeholders

  • Sharp product sense and an ability to think broadly and cross-functionally about model quality in the context of user experience

  • Bonus

    • Experience with speech or audio

Office

  • San Francisco, CA

About this role

As a Platform Engineer at Speak, you’ll be the driving force behind the reliability and resilience of the systems that power our global language learning experience. You’ll lead efforts to scale our infrastructure, harden our platform, and ensure that our services are fast, available, and reliable for millions of users around the world.

You’ll work across our stack—from Kubernetes on GCP to our Node.js APIs, Postgres, and Redis —building robust infrastructure and operational tooling. You’ll own incident response, observability, and SLOs while embedding a culture of reliability throughout the engineering org.

Speak is growing rapidly, and we’re pushing our systems harder every day. This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of our platform as we scale to the next 10x of users.

What you’ll be doing

  • Own the reliability of Speak’s infrastructure across GCP, Kubernetes, and our Node.js/Postgres stack

  • Lead response for P0/P1 incidents, drive postmortems, and ensure we’re learning from every outage

  • Improve observability, alerting, and on-call processes so we catch issues before users do

  • Define and drive adoption of SLOs/SLAs for core systems and services

  • Build tools and frameworks to make reliability easier for product engineers—think safer deploys and infrastructure automation

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and ML teams to ensure reliability is baked into everything we build

  • Set short term and long term roadmaps to ensure stability for our growing user base.

  • Be a thought leader and coach around platform and infrastructure engineering principles—blameless culture, operational maturity, and continuous improvement

What we’re looking for

  • 7+ years of experience in SRE, DevOps, Platform, and/or infrastructure-focused engineering roles, ideally with experience leading or mentoring others

  • Strong experience with GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, Redis, and observability tooling like Prometheus and Sentry

  • Proven track record of improving reliability, scaling systems, and reducing incident frequency and severity with high traffic systems

  • Strong incident management and root cause analysis skills—you know how to lead under pressure

  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and deployment safety tooling

  • Strong systems thinking, with the ability to identify failure points and proactively harden services

  • Deep sense of ownership and a desire to make infrastructure a force multiplier for the rest of the org

Bonus

  • Familiarity with cost optimization strategies in cloud-native environments

  • Background in security, chaos engineering, or disaster recovery planning

  • Contributions to internal tooling, automation, or developer productivity initiatives

Why work at Speak

  1. Join a fantastic, tight-knit team at the right time: we're growing very quickly, we've most recently raised our Series C from some of the top investors in the valley, and we've achieved product-market fit in our initial markets. 이 역할은 퍼포먼스 마케팅, CRM, 퍼널 최적화, 신규 채널 발굴 등 전방위적 마케팅 전략을 이끄는 동시에, 브랜드 및 프로덕트 팀과의 협업을 통해 장기적인 성장을 도모합니다. 또한, 스픽의 글로벌 그로스 조직과 긴밀히 협력하며, 한국 시장에서의 성공을 기반으로 글로벌 스케일업에 기여하게 됩니다.

포지션 정보

  • 직무명: Head of Growth

  • 근무지: 서울, 대한민국

  • 고용 형태: 정규직

포지션 업무

  • 한국 시장의 성장 목표를 책임집니다. 데이터 기반의 사용자 획득 및 리텐션 전략을 통해 구독자 수를 확대하고 LTV:CAC 비율을 개선합니다.

  • 연간 $NM 이상의 마케팅 예산을 운영하며, 높은 크리에이티브 생산성과 실험, 효율적인 매체 집행을 통해 퍼포먼스 마케팅을 리드하고 확장합니다.

  • 새로운 성장 채널(예: 프로덕트 기반 성장 루프, 대체 유료 채널, 가격/패키징 혁신 등)을 식별하고, 검증하고, 스케일합니다.

  • Paid UA, CRM 등 다양한 기능을 아우르는 그로스 팀을 구성하고 코칭합니다.

  • Paid 마케팅, CRM, 퍼널 성과, 프로덕트 사용 등 전반적인 지표에 대해 일간/주간 수준의 가시성을 확보할 수 있도록 리포팅 시스템을 구축하고 최적화합니다.

  • 프로덕트, 브랜드, 글로벌 센트럴 그로스 팀과 협업하여 한국 시장의 기회에 맞는 전략을 수립하고 실행합니다.

  • 한국 시장의 브랜드 포지셔닝과 커뮤니케이션 전략 수립에 기여하여 전체적인 시장 성장을 지원합니다.

필수 역량

  • 검증된 그로스 리더십 경험: 연간 $10M 이상의 마케팅 예산을 운영하며 웹과 앱 전반에 걸쳐 성과를 만들어낸, 고속 성장 기술/소비자 스타트업에서의 7년 이상의 경력

  • 풀 스택 그로스 전문성: 퍼포먼스 마케팅, 퍼널 최적화, 실험 설계/운영 등 전 영역에 걸친 실무 및 전략적 경험

  • 빌더 마인드셋: 시스템, 대시보드, 프로세스를 처음부터 설계하고 구축해본 경험이 있으며, 전략 수립과 실행을 모두 주도할 수 있는 역량

  • 강력한 실행력: 다양한 성과 지표를 통합적으로 해석하고, 마케팅/프로덕트/브랜드 팀과 함께 실행으로 연결하는 능력

  • 팀 리딩 및 코칭 경험: 뛰어난 마케팅/그로스 팀을 구성하고, 코칭 및 성장을 주도해본 실질적 경험

  • 한국 시장에 대한 깊은 통찰과 글로벌 마인드셋: 한국 소비자에 대한 높은 이해도를 바탕으로, 글로벌 베스트 프랙티스를 효과적으로 현지화할 수 있는 능력

  • 영어 비즈니스 커뮤니케이션 능력: 글로벌 팀과 원활하게 협업하고, 한국 시장 전략을 글로벌 목표와 정렬시킬 수 있는 커뮤니케이션 역량

💬 동료의 코멘트

스픽의 브랜드 마케터 두현입니다. 스픽은 지난 5년 간 빠르게 성장했고, 한국에서 가장 높은 브랜드 인지도를 가지고 있고, 팬덤도 보유하고 있습니다. 또한 그로스 전략과 측정 등에 있어, 세계에서 가장 앞서가는 솔루션을 도입하고 있으며, C레벨부터 실무진까지 그로스에 대한 이해도가 정말 높은 팀입니다. 

눈부시게 성장해온 스픽, 현재는 그로스 마케팅의 변곡점에 와 있습니다. 지금까지 스픽은 시장의 문법을 그대로 따라오지 않았습니다. 때로는 완전히 새로운 시도를 하며 새로운 성장을 도모해왔죠. 스픽의 마케팅이 돋보이는 이유이고요. 저는 스픽이 계속해서 스픽만의 방식으로 성장하기를 바랍니다. 탁월한 그로스 마케팅팀을 리드해 계속해서 이전에 없던 성장을 만들어낼 리더를 찾고 있습니다.

About This Role

We’re looking for a Head of Growth (Korea) to lead Speak’s next stage of growth in its most important market. Based in Seoul, this person will be fully responsible for driving sustainable user acquisition, revenue expansion, and long-term retention in Korea—setting the vision, building the systems, and leading a high-performing team to deliver bold business outcomes.

As a key member of both the Korea leadership team and Speak’s global Growth team, you’ll oversee all aspects of our local growth strategy—including paid media, lifecycle marketing, funnel optimization, and new growth experiments. You’ll also act as a key advisor to brand and product teams to ensure our broader consumer business in Korea is set up for long-term success.

What you’ll be doing

  • Own and deliver Korea’s growth targets—growing our subscriber base while improving LTV:CAC through data-driven acquisition and retention strategies

  • Lead and scale our performance marketing efforts, managing >$00M+ annual budget with high creative output, experimentation, and media efficiency

  • Architect and align Korea’s full-funnel growth strategy across Paid, CRM, Brand, Influencer, and Partnerships, driving measurable impact from upper-funnel investment, establishing incrementality frameworks, and ensuring channel synergy across acquisition and retention

  • Identify, validate, and scale new growth channels (e.g. product-led growth loops, alternative paid media, pricing/packaging innovation)

  • Manage and mentor a multidisciplinary growth team across paid UA, CRM and more

  • Build and optimize reporting systems for daily/weekly visibility across paid marketing, CRM, funnel performance, and product usage

  • Partner with Brand and Content teams to align messaging, creative strategy, and audience targeting with performance objectives

  • Collaborate with product, brand, and central growth teams to align roadmaps with local market opportunities

  • Contribute to Korea’s brand positioning and comms strategy in service of broader market growth

What we’re looking for

  • Proven growth leadership: 7+ years in high-growth tech or consumer startups, with ownership of $10M+ annual marketing budgets across both web and app

  • Full-stack growth expertise: Deep hands-on experience across performance marketing, upper-funnel brand integration, funnel optimization, and experimentation—able to translate brand awareness and messaging strategy into measurable subscriber growth and improved LTV:CAC

  • Builder mentality: Comfortable building systems, dashboards, and processes from scratch—while operating at both strategic and executional levels

  • Strong operator: Ability to synthesize performance signals and drive cross-functional execution across marketing, product, and brand

  • Team leader & coach: Track record of building, mentoring, and managing high-performing growth and marketing teams

  • Local fluency, global mindset: Deep understanding of Korean consumer behavior with the ability to adapt and apply global best practices

  • Business fluency in English: Capable of leading collaboration with global stakeholders and aligning local efforts to global goals

Why work at Speak

  1. Join a fantastic, tight-knit team at the right time: we're growing very quickly, we've most recently raised our Series C from some of the top investors in the valley, and we've achieved product-market fit in our initial markets. You'd join at a magical time when a single person could significantly change the course of the company.

  2. Do your life's work with people you’ll love working with: we care strongly about our craft and want every person at Speak to feel like they're growing every day. We believe in the idea that working with people you both enjoy and have respect for makes everything better. We hire thoughtfully and only work with people we admire deeply.

  3. Global in nature: We're live in over 40 countries and launching in a number of new markets soon. We have dedicated offices in San Francisco, Ljubljana, Seoul, and Tokyo, and you’ll have the opportunity to talk to users in each of these regions on a regular basis as well as travel.

  4. Impact people's lives in a major way: Learning a language is one of the single most life-changing skills one can learn, and right now 99% of people never achieve their goal because the process is broken. We’re helping millions of people achieve their goals and improve their lives.

Speak does not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

About This Role

Speak is looking for a Brand & PR Manager to help shape our identity and expand our reach in Japan. This role is both strategic and hands-on - you’ll define the roadmap for how we earn attention and trust in one of our most important markets.

What you'll be doing

  • Own and evolve Speak’s brand in Japan

  • Build trust and awareness through Brand, PR/Media, and Owned Social

  • Define clear messaging and creative direction

  • Research, evaluate, and test channels with a data-first approach (e.g., TVCM, OOH, Digital)

  • Engage media, journalists, and a PR agency to earn exposure

  • Analyze brand performance and campaign impact using both qualitative and quantitative data

  • Plan and test localized, high-impact social content

  • Share findings and updates clearly with internal stakeholders

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of experience in brand marketing / PR, with a proven track record of delivering measurable impact

  • Exceptional storytelling skills to shape brand narratives across multiple channels

  • Strong data fluency to evaluate brand investments and extract actionable insights

  • Demonstrated ability to manage media relationships and secure earned coverage

  • Strong capabilities in content planning

  • Operates independently, with urgency and ownership

  • Native Japanese & Business English is mandatory

Nice to haves

  • Start-up experience is strongly preferred

  • App marketing experience

Why work at Speak

  1. Join a fantastic, tight-knit team at the right time: we're growing very quickly, we've most recently raised our Series C from some of the top investors in the valley, and we've achieved product-market fit in our initial markets. You'd join at a magical time when a single person could significantly change the course of the company.

  2. Do your life's work with people you’ll love working with: we care strongly about our craft and want every person at Speak to feel like they're growing every day. We believe in the idea that working with people you both enjoy and have respect for makes everything better. We hire thoughtfully and only work with people we admire deeply.

  3. Global in nature: We're live in over 40 countries and launching in a number of new markets soon. We have dedicated offices in San Francisco, Ljubljana, Seoul, and Tokyo, and you’ll have the opportunity to talk to users in each of these regions on a regular basis as well as travel.

  4. Impact people's lives in a major way: Learning a language is one of the single most life-changing skills one can learn, and right now 99% of people never achieve their goal because the process is broken. We’re helping millions of people achieve their goals and improve their lives.

  • Design and manage the analytics infrastructure that supports accurate, fast, and scalable insights across markets and platforms

  • Build and operationalize frameworks for measuring CAC, LTV, ROI, incrementality, and media efficiency.

  • Accelerate experimentation velocity by supporting the design, execution, and analysis of A/B and market-level tests across creatives, lifecycle, and product surfaces.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product, engineering, and finance teams to identify levers for acquisition, retention, and monetization.

  • Shape forward-looking strategy by analyzing media fatigue, market saturation, and competitive benchmarks.

  • Hire and mentor junior team members, scaling the team alongside the business


What we’re looking for

  • 5–7+ years of experience in high-performance analytics roles, with at least 3 years focused specifically on growth or marketing analytics.

  • Deep familiarity with multi-channel marketing measurement, including attribution systems, LTV/CAC frameworks, and MMM/incrementality testing.

  • Expertise in SQL, plus hands-on experience with BI tools like Mode, Looker, or Tableau.

  • Experience designing and running marketing and pricing/packaging experiments (creative tests, landing pages, CRM, geo tests, etc.).

  • Demonstrated ability to influence growth, product, finance, and marketing stakeholders with clear, actionable insights.

  • Strategic mindset—someone who can zoom out and prioritize, not just execute analyses.

  • Clear, compelling communicator who can explain complex ideas to non-technical audiences.

  • Bonus points for

    • Experience working on multi platform consumer subscription or mobile app products

    • Exposure to marketing mix modeling (MMM) and brand measurement

    • Proficiency in Python or R for deeper modeling or statistical analysis

    • Prior experience building out marketing analytics functions from scratch

    • Global growth experience or exposure to multi-geo go-to-market strategies

  • Empowerment: Proactively evaluate and evolve our tool stack to support stakeholders to make answering questions with data as frictionless as possible.

  • Collaboration and Systems Thinking: As a central node on our team, you'll partner with product managers, analysts, and other engineers to design data solutions and processes for business needs.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of relevant experience

  • Data Modeling: Deep understanding of big data warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift), theories, principles, and practices. Ability to design, implement, and manage data warehouses and cloud pipelines (GCP, AWS, dbt) effectively.

  • Programming Skills: Strong proficiency in SQL and comfort working with Python. Ability to write efficient, reliable, and maintainable code.

  • Tooling: Experience managing data platform tooling, such as data ingestion, reverse ETL, visualization, data observability, alerting, etc.

  • Business Acumen: Translate stakeholder needs into robust data models and metrics with a deep understanding of the product and business model.

  • Debugging Skills: Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to approach complex challenges methodically, including data inconsistency issues.

About this role

This is an extraordinary moment to join us. We're in the middle of a fundamental agentic shift in software development, and are embracing the change. We're operating in an agentic-first world, where the role of a builder is shifting from writing every line of code to designing systems that build, test, and improve themselves.

At Speak, you'll use AI agents as core collaborators in your day-to-day workflow—helping you move faster, explore more ideas, and focus on the highest-impact problems. That means embracing ambiguity, iterating quickly, and working fluidly across functions—not just within a single discipline.

We're looking for a Full-stack Engineer who is excited to rethink how work gets done in an AI-native environment, and who want to help define what building looks like in this new paradigm.

This role spans the entire stack — while initial projects may lean frontend, expect to pivot into backend work as well, contributing to novel AI-powered product experiences. The ideal candidate will have experience working in close coordination with product, design, and machine learning teams, as well as have a background in building polished consumer applications. This role sits at the center of developing our newest products focused on programmatic, conversationally-driven language learning and will be an instrumental contributor to the future of our company.

What you'll be doing

  • Building novel AI-driven product experiences and user interfaces on the web

  • Owning the entire development cycle of features, from conception to production

  • You'll be able to write code very quickly, ship frequently, and make a huge impact on our business by helping us scale our content

What we're looking for

  • 4+ years of experience building highly polished web-based product experiences, including extensive experience with React

  • Experience using coding agents (e.g. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) as core collaborators in your day-to-day workflow — not just as autocomplete, but as active partners in designing, testing, and shipping.

  • You appreciate balancing doing things the "right way" but also can build things scrappily if necessary

  • You enjoy shipping things quickly and frequently

  • You're an excellent communicator and enjoy collaborating with people across all functions

  • We welcome applicants across all levels of engineering, including mid, senior, and staff.

Office

  • San Francisco, CA

Why work at Speak

  1. Join a fantastic, tight-knit team at the right time: we're growing very quickly, we've most recently raised our Series C from some of the top investors in the valley, and we've achieved product-market fit in our initial markets. You'd join at a magical time when a single person could significantly change the course of the company.

We believe in the idea that working with people you both enjoy and have respect for makes everything better. We hire thoughtfully and only work with people we admire deeply.

  3. Global in nature: We're live in over 40 countries and launching in a number of new markets soon. We have dedicated offices in San Francisco, Ljubljana, Seoul, and Tokyo, and you’ll have the opportunity to talk to users in each of these regions on a regular basis as well as travel.

  • Create and manage a pipeline of Enterprise accounts from inbound and outbound activity to consistently meet or surpass sales targets

  • Conduct thorough analysis to create account plans that outline company priorities and initiatives, multi-threading at senior level to build on expansion opportunities

  • Manage a book of business by tiering accounts and initiating techniques to drive upsell ARR

  • Co-create with cross-functional partners (CSMs, SDRs, Marketing, Product) to expertly position Speak, drive deals forward and ensure customer success

  • Leverage opportunities to advance executive-level relationships through in-person meetings and networking opportunities

  • Able to analyze market data, adapt strategies, and contribute to sales and operational success

  • Fluency in business English; communicating with the global team at Speak on a daily level should not be a blocker to get things done

  • Travel up to 20%

We'd love to hear from you if you have:

  • Proven experience closing new and upsell sales, over 5+ years, for an HR-focused software or SaaS business with a book of customers (>5000 FTEs), selling to executives

  • Consistent performance meeting pipeline generation targets for net new business

  • Demonstrated experience successfully managing complex sales cycles (3-12 months)

  • A sales methodology and process that creates value for customers

  • Exposure to today’s best AI Sales Tech stack tools

  • Successful experience in full funnel selling - outbound process, SDR alignment, trial management, business case development, proposal management, negotiation, upsell planning, etc.

While it’s not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • Experience selling EdTech or language learning solutions to HR audiences at an executive level (Learning & Development, Talent a plus)

  • Demonstrated ability to succeed in a changing environment

  • Knowledge of successful land and expand motion

Why work at Speak

  1. Join a fantastic, tight-knit team at the right time: we're growing very quickly, we've most recently raised our Series C from some of the top investors in the valley, and we've achieved product-market fit in our initial markets. You'd join at a magical time when a single person could significantly change the course of the company.

  2. Do your life's work with people you’ll love working with: we care strongly about our craft and want every person at Speak to feel like they're growing every day. We believe in the idea that working with people you both enjoy and have respect for makes everything better. We hire thoughtfully and only work with people we admire deeply.

  3. Global in nature: We're live in over 40 countries and launching in a number of new markets soon. We have dedicated offices in San Francisco, Ljubljana, Seoul, and Tokyo, and you’ll have the opportunity to talk to users in each of these regions on a regular basis as well as travel.

  4. Impact people's lives in a major way: Learning a language is one of the single most life-changing skills one can learn, and right now 99% of people never achieve their goal because the process is broken. We’re helping millions of people achieve their goals and improve their lives.

This person will own the systems + process layer that sits between GTM strategy and day-to-day execution, so that Sales Leadership can focus on coaching, hiring, and selling while the team runs on predictable operating cadences.

This is a highly cross-functional role, partnering closely with Sales Leadership, Sales, Finance, Customer Success, Marketing, and Product. The ideal candidate is comfortable being both strategic and hands-on, and thrives in fast-moving environments where “good enough now” systems are built quickly and then improved iteratively. Run the sales ops cadence

  • Build dashboards for pipeline coverage, forecast vs target, stage conversion, cycle time, and leading indicators.

  • Identify and clean the highest-impact data issues (owner, stage, amount, close date, product, region, source).

  • Set up discounting guardrails and a clear approval matrix.

  • Run territory and account assignment processes.

  • Support lead routing logic and SLA monitoring.

  • Set up and execute B2B lead generation campaigns across LinkedIn, Google/Naver SEM, display, and other relevant digital channels targeting both MQL and SQL audiences

  • Manage end-to-end campaign operations including asset trafficking, tracking setup (UTMs, pixels, tags), and pre-launch QA

  • Execute A/B tests across targeting parameters, ad copy, creative assets, landing pages, and channels to continuously improve lead quality and conversion rates

  • Coordinate with translators to adapt and localize campaigns for APAC and other target markets (i.e. LATAM)

2. Content & Asset Collaboration

  • Work closely with designers and content writers to develop high-performing lead generation assets including whitepapers, gated content, webinars, landing pages, and image/video creatives

  • Provide performance-driven feedback on creative assets to improve engagement and conversion metrics

  • Review landing pages and user flows to ensure accuracy, brand alignment, and conversion readiness

  • Support the setup and monitoring of A/B tests on landing pages and creative assets

3. Performance Reporting & Data Analysis

  • Build, maintain, and update campaign dashboards and KPI reports across all active platforms

  • Collect, validate, and organize performance data for weekly, monthly, and quarterly reviews

  • Analyze funnel metrics (CTR, CVR, CPL, MQL-to-SQL conversion rates, drop-off points) to surface trends and actionable insights

  • Prepare clear performance summaries and optimization recommendations for internal stakeholders

4. Budget & Administrative Operations

  • Support budget tracking, PO processing, vendor invoicing, and cost reconciliation

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial documentation to support monthly and quarterly reporting cycles

What we're looking for

  • 3–5 years of hands-on experience in B2B digital marketing, with a focus on lead generation and performance marketing

  • Proven experience running paid campaigns on LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Naver, and Google Ads (SEM)

  • Strong understanding of the B2B funnel and MQL/SQL definitions and handoff processes

  • Experience with A/B testing methodologies across targeting, content, and creative

  • Proficiency in analytics and reporting tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Salesforce, HubSpot, Looker, or equivalent) with strong data literacy

  • Excellent communication and project coordination skills

  • Korean & English language proficiency skills

Nice-to-have's

  • Experience supporting APAC or multi-market campaigns with localization

  • Familiarity with marketing automation platforms (HubSpot or similar)

  • Experience working with gated content strategies: whitepapers, webinars, lead magnets

  • Background collaborating with creative teams (designers, copywriters) in a performance marketing context

  • Experience coordinating with external digital agencies

  • Work with AI: consistently experiment with AI tools, prototype new workflows, and partner with internal AI teams to improve AI-assisted content generation—driving major efficiency and quality gains across Spanish content.

  • Mentor and coach junior team members and contractors.

  • Native-level proficiency in English

  • 4+ years of Spanish curriculum design at an ed tech company

  • Deep expertise in Spanish pedagogy and spoken fluency development

  • Exceptional user empathy and strong creative instincts — able to craft content that balances engagement, pedagogy, and what resonates with learners

  • Strong content analytics intuition: able to identify which engagement and learning metrics matter and translate insights into curriculum improvements

  • Strong writing, editing, and content creation skills, with the ability to ship high-quality lessons independently and make sound decisions with minimal oversight

  • Strong technical fluency with modern tools and ability to ramp quickly on new systems

  • Operationally strong: excellent project management, ability to juggle multiple work streams, and comfort working in fast-paced environments

  • Track record of collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams (e.g., Product, Engineering, Business Operations/Analytics, Marketing)

  • Creative and resourceful problem solver: enjoys prototyping new content approaches and thinking outside the box to solve learner problems even under constraints

  • Effective communicator and collaborator who builds trust across teams and with leadership

  • People management experience

  • Experience with LMS tools

  • Willingness to be based in San Francisco

  • Deep understanding of APAC business culture, particularly in Korea, Japan, and/or Taiwan, with the ability to navigate cultural nuances and build strong relationships

  • Experience in fast-growth environments, ideally at companies scaling rapidly in APAC markets

About this role

Speak is scaling fast across APAC. We've more than doubled our team across Korea, Japan, and Taiwan in just over a year, with continued hiring through 2026. Our People Ops team runs lean, and we're adding a Generalist to strengthen our operational capacity across all three markets.

You'll manage key aspects of the employee lifecycle (onboarding, offboarding, contracts, HRIS, and multi-market compliance), improve and document the processes that support it, and over time help the team turn what works into scalable infrastructure. We're at the stage where the processes that supported a smaller team need to become the systems that scale across three markets, and you'll be a key part of making that happen alongside the rest of the team.

This role is meaningful and hands-on. You'll work across three legal entities, solve real problems that affect how people experience Speak in APAC, and contribute to building something that grows with the company. If you care about getting details right and want to do impactful work at a company that's still early enough to shape, this is a strong fit.

What you'll be doing

Employee lifecycle operations and management

  • Run the full FTE lifecycle across KR, JP, and TW: onboarding, contracts, probation, offboarding, HRIS, and more - maintaining accurate employee data across the three entities with by conducting audits and resolving gaps

  • Track multi-market compliance across the region: flag regulatory changes with a recommended action, and keep the handbook up-to-date

  • Be the go-to resource for employees across the region on lifecycle and People Ops questions

  • Partner closely with the Global People Ops team to keep global processes aligned while reflecting local nuance across APAC markets

Benefits and program support

  • Administer local & market-specific benefits and perks (e.g., health checkups, insurance enrollment, local perks)

  • Help run People programs operationally: engagement surveys, performance review cycles, and other recurring processes

Process improvement and documentation

  • Map existing workflows across the three markets, identify where they break or slow down, and propose improvements together with the team

  • Help build and maintain the APAC People Ops SOP and playbook library. The team sets direction together; you build, document, and keep them current

  • Help design and implement workflow improvements using AI and automation (contract generation, onboarding triggers, data entry, intake systems) to reduce manual load and increase team capacity

  • Collect feedback from employees and partner teams to make sure improvements focus on areas that drive the most impact

What we're looking for

If you don't think you meet all of the criteria below but still are interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box, and we're looking for someone excited to join the team.

  • 4~6 years of experience in people operations, HR, or related field

  • You break down ambiguous problems, build a plan, and see it through. You manage projects, not just tasks

  • You're a strong communicator with high EQ. You navigate sensitive conversations, align multiple stakeholders, and adapt your style to the audience

  • You prioritize well and make trade-offs confidently, especially when resources are limited and everything feels urgent

  • People trust you with sensitive information and know you'll follow through

  • You're curious about AI and automation, and you pick up new tools quickly

  • You can operate without clear direction in a fast-moving environment

  • You're comfortable communicating in English for day-to-day collaboration and basic business writing, as you'll work closely with our global team

  • You're based in Seoul and available for hybrid in-office work

Who you are

  • You care about getting the details right, but you don't lose sight of what actually matters

  • You're energized by building things that don't exist yet

  • You stay calm when things get busy and bring clarity to ambiguous situations

  • You enjoy working across cultures and contexts, and you adapt your approach rather than defaulting to one-size-fits-all

  • You notice when something is broken and fix it without being asked

Bonus points:

  • You have experience working across multiple legal entities or countries

  • You've built or significantly improved an HR process or SOP from scratch

  • You've worked at a startup or high-growth company before

Why work at Speak

  1. Join a fantastic, tight-knit team at the right time: we're growing very quickly, we've most recently raised our Series C from some of the top investors in the valley, and we've achieved product-market fit in our initial markets. You'd join at a magical time when a single person could significantly change the course of the company.

  2. Do your life's work with people you’ll love working with: we care strongly about our craft and want every person at Speak to feel like they're growing every day. We believe in the idea that working with people you both enjoy and have respect for makes everything better. We hire thoughtfully and only work with people we admire deeply.

  3. Global in nature: We're live in over 40 countries and launching in a number of new markets soon. We have dedicated offices in San Francisco, Ljubljana, Seoul, and Tokyo, and you’ll have the opportunity to talk to users in each of these regions on a regular basis as well as travel.

  4. Impact people's lives in a major way: Learning a language is one of the single most life-changing skills one can learn, and right now 99% of people never achieve their goal because the process is broken. We’re helping millions of people achieve their goals and improve their lives.

About this role

We're seeking a Production Manager to lead Speak's LA video production studio. You'll establish a distinct visual standard across all video lessons while managing studio operations and team.

You'll implement a cohesive style through operational oversight, attend shoots to provide strategic direction, and document creative standards enabling team sustainability. You'll also pilot AI tools to improve post-production efficiency — understanding when AI enhances versus compromises quality. If you're energized by elevating production standards, building systems, and exploring AI workflows in media production, we'd love to meet you.

What you'll be doing

  • Oversee Execution of Creative Style — Implement and maintain a cohesive creative style through operational oversight, collaborating on studio, editing, and hiring changes that ensure quality control while documenting standards in a comprehensive style guide.

  • Oversee Shoots with Production Management Expertise — Attend shoots to provide strategic oversight and creative direction, empowering the studio team on day-to-day tasks while intervening on critical decisions related to vision and on-screen quality.

  • Build a Repeatable Creative Playbook and Foster Team Growth — Document creative standards, workflows, and quality checklists to enable independent execution, building systems that increase output velocity and streamline collaboration while partnering with post-production to ensure edits, pacing, graphics, and sound align with creative vision.

  • Introduce AI-Enhanced Production Workflows — Identify and pilot AI tools that improve efficiency or creative output, focusing on post-production tools, video generation platforms, and AI-assisted editing while understanding when AI enhances versus compromises quality and documenting recommendations with tested tools and workflows.

What we're looking for

jobs.title: Workplace Experience Manager

About the role

As Speak continues to grow globally, our San Francisco HQ has become our largest and most active hub. We’re looking for a highly organized, people-centered Workplace Experience Manager to help shape and elevate our in-office experience.

This role sits within the People Operations team and plays a critical part in ensuring our office runs smoothly, feels welcoming, and reflects our company culture. You’ll be responsible for everything from office operations and vendor management to new hire experience and events. As our first hire dedicated to this function, you’ll have the opportunity to build foundational systems and processes that scale with us.

We’re looking for someone who’s deeply motivated by creating an environment where people feel supported, connected, and excited to come to work. This role is based in San Francisco and requires regular in-office presence (four days per week, up to five when needed).

What you’ll be doing

You’ll serve as the primary point of contact for our office.

Office Operations & Facilities

  • Manage daily operations of our San Francisco HQ, ensuring everything runs efficiently for our local employees.

  • Manage relationships with building management, vendors, and service providers (e.g., catering, cleaning, maintenance, security).

  • Oversee mail management, including incoming and outgoing deliveries.

  • Manage seating arrangements, facilities projects, and general office upkeep.

  • Track and manage office supplies, food & beverage, and equipment inventory.

  • Develop and implement efficient office processes and systems to optimize workflows.

  • Ensure compliance with workplace safety, security, and emergency preparedness protocols.

Employee Experience

  • Create a welcoming, inclusive, and productive environment for employees and visitors alike.

  • Manage front-of-house operations: entry, guest check-ins, and visitor flow.

  • Act as a cultural ambassador by bringing our values to life through daily operations and moments that foster connection.

  • Plan and execute local team events, celebrations, swag, and engagement programs that foster connection in SF office and across global hubs.

  • Play a key support role in planning and logistics for our annual company offsite.

  • Organize culture-building initiatives that reinforce Speak’s values and ways of working.

  • Support initiatives that strengthen belonging and cross-team collaboration.

Onboarding & Employee Support

  • Deliver an exceptional onboarding experience for new hires, including Day 1 tour and logistics.

  • Help coordinate logistics for visitors as needed.

  • Be the first responder for workplace questions and requests.

Budget & Vendor Management

  • Manage the SF office budget for supplies, food, events, and vendors.

  • Negotiate and manage vendor contracts to ensure quality and cost-effectiveness.

  • Continuously assess and improve operational processes for efficiency and scalability.

What we’re looking for

If you don't think you meet all of the criteria below but still are interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box, and we're looking for someone excited to join the team.

  • You have at least 4 years of experience in office operations, event operations, or similar operational / hospitality roles;

  • You’re able to run day-to-day operations efficiently while also building processes and programs from the ground up;

  • You have strong organizational skills and attention to detail;

  • You demonstrate effective interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build trust and collaborate across all levels of the company;

  • You have experience managing vendors, budgets, and contracts with a high degree of responsibility;

  • You’re proficient in tools like GSuite, Slack, and basic project management systems;

  • You’re able and willing to work from the SF office at least four days a week (and up to five when needed);

  • You’re physically able to lift up to 20 pounds.

Who you are

You’re right for this role if:

  • You value empathy and customer service.

  • You take pride in the details.

  • You love creating structure and order but are flexible when things change.

  • You take initiative and consistently find ways to get things done efficiently.

  • You have a positive attitude and are flexible when things change;

  • You enjoy building community and making people’s days a little brighter.

  • You have a growth mindset and are excited to help shape what Workplace Experience means at Speak.

Bonus points:

  • You have experience with a globally distributed workforce

  • You’ve worked at a technology start-up or high-growth company

  • You have event experience

Why work at Speak

  1. Join a fantastic, tight-knit team at the right time: we're growing very quickly, we've most recently raised our Series C from some of the top investors in the valley, and we've achieved product-market fit in our initial markets. You'd join at a magical time when a single person could significantly change the course of the company.

  2. Do your life's work with people you’ll love working with: we care strongly about our craft and want every person at Speak to feel like they're growing every day. We believe in the idea that working with people you both enjoy and have respect for makes everything better. We hire thoughtfully and only work with people we admire deeply.

  3. Global in nature: We're live in over 40 countries and launching in a number of new markets soon. We have dedicated offices in San Francisco, Ljubljana, Seoul, and Tokyo, and you’ll have the opportunity to talk to users in each of these regions on a regular basis as well as travel.

  4. Impact people's lives in a major way: Learning a language is one of the single most life-changing skills one can learn, and right now 99% of people never achieve their goal because the process is broken. We’re helping millions of people achieve their goals and improve their lives.

Speak does not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

About this role

Speak's Finance team is AI-first, fast, comprehensive, data driven, and expected to punch well above its weight. The Senior Finance Analyst role will increase the team's throughput on the analytical work that actually moves decisions: building and owning core models, running planning cycles, and partnering with functional leaders to translate strategy into measurable financial plans.

This is not a reporting-and-maintenance role. The ideal candidate brings genuine analytical horsepower, operates with a high degree of independence, and has the judgment to know when to go deep and when to move fast. They will be one of the primary sources of financial truth for the business.

The role will report to the Head of Finance and will partner across all areas of the business to drive our highest-priority planning workstreams in 2026.

What you'll be doing

  • Be the trusted enterprise GTM cross-functional partner — own standing finance cadences with global enterprise GTM team; provide realtime insights and hold GTM leadership accountable to financial decision making.

  • Own enterprise GTM financial modeling and BvAs end-to-end — build and maintain the GTM forecast, ARR model, and GTM P&L, partnering closely with GTM Leadership and RevOps.

  • Own enterprise quote capacity and quota attainment modeling end-to-end - build and maintain the capacity planning model, attainment model, and commissions calculations, partnering closely with GTM Leadership and RevOps.

  • Be the trusted Talent and People cross-functional partner — own standing finance cadences with Talent and People teams to drive headcount, bands, and people costs decision-making.

  • Drive headcount and OPEX planning — own headcount approvals and benchmarking, payroll forecasting, and vendor-level OPEX forecasting across the business.

  • Partner on strategic planning — contribute to the Long Range Plan, compensation strategy, and new market investment frameworks alongside the broader Finance team.

  • Build decision-support analyses — turn ambiguous business questions into structured recommendations on investments, pricing, market entry, and resource allocation.

  • Be a trusted cross-functional partner — own standing finance cadences with S4B, People, and other functional partners; show up with accurate numbers and a clear point of view.

What we're looking for

Minimum requirements

  • 4-7 years in FP&A, strategic finance, investment banking, consulting, or a comparable analytical role — with prior startup or high-growth tech experience strongly preferred.

  • Advanced financial modeling skills (Excel or Google Sheets): driver-based forecasting, scenario analysis, sensitivity tables, and the ability to build clean, auditable models from scratch.

  • Strong AI tool enablement, able to work with frontier models and AI tools and validate the fidelity of the output.

  • Direct experience supporting full planning cycles: annual operating plan, quarterly re-forecasts, and board or investor-facing materials.

  • Fluency in SaaS and B2B metrics — ARR, NRR, LTV/CAC, payback period, quota capacity, and unit economics are part of your daily vocabulary.

  • Strong written communication: structures analyses so non-finance stakeholders can read, review, and act on them without a translator.

  • High ownership and high integrity — treats models and processes as yours to improve, not just maintain; handles confidential data with discretion.

Why work at Speak

  1. Join a fantastic, tight-knit team at the right time: we're growing very quickly, we've most recently raised our Series C from some of the top investors in the valley, and we've achieved product-market fit in our initial markets. You'd join at a magical time when a single person could significantly change the course of the company.

  2. Do your life's work with people you’ll love working with: we care strongly about our craft and want every person at Speak to feel like they're growing every day. We believe in the idea that working with people you both enjoy and have respect for makes everything better. We hire thoughtfully and only work with people we admire deeply.

  3. Global in nature: We're live in over 40 countries and launching in a number of new markets soon. We have dedicated offices in San Francisco, Ljubljana, Seoul, and Tokyo, and you’ll have the opportunity to talk to users in each of these regions on a regular basis as well as travel.

  4. Impact people's lives in a major way: Learning a language is one of the single most life-changing skills one can learn, and right now 99% of people never achieve their goal because the process is broken. We’re helping millions of people achieve their goals and improve their lives.

Speak is building a human-level, AI-powered tutor in your pocket: a conversation-first experience that lets learners actually speak, get instant feedback, and progress through carefully designed lessons. The result is a complete path from beginner to confident speaker across multiple languages.

Speak first launched in South Korea in 2019, where Speak has now become the number one language learning app, and we now serve learners across many markets and 15+ languages. Speak is one of the world’s leading AI companies, with over $150m raised in venture investment from OpenAI, Accel, Founders Fund, Khosla Ventures, and more, with a distributed team across San Francisco, Seoul, Tokyo, Taipei, and Ljubljana.

About This Role

We're looking for a Senior Accountant to serve as the operational core of the Finance team in San Francisco. You'll own the day-to-day accounting while continuously improving how we work. This is a hands-on role with room to grow as Speak scales.

We’re especially excited about candidates who are AI-native and fluent in frontier tech environments. You proactively explore new tools, can quickly learn unfamiliar systems, and enjoy tightening integrations and automations to make workflows faster, cleaner, and more scalable.

You're someone who stays on top of multiple workstreams without things slipping, surfaces issues before they become problems, and genuinely enjoys figuring out how to make processes more robust.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own P2P in Ramp (vendor onboarding support, invoice processing, coding, policy enforcement)

  • Run day-to-day T&E (cards, reimbursements, employee support)

  • Own contractor payments in Deel end-to-end (routing, approvals, onboarding/offboarding coordination)

  • Manage global creator payouts (onboarding, invoices, payment cycles)

  • Own key parts of the 5-business-day close in Campfire (recons, variance investigation, clean tool-to-ERP sync)

  • Maintain transaction integrity across the finance stack and fix integration breaks

  • Support audit requests with clear schedules, support, and process documentation

  • Improve workflows with an AI-native mindset (automation, tighter integrations, better controls)

  • Support ad hoc finance ops projects as needed

What We're Looking For

Minimum requirements

  • 3–5 years of accounting experience, preferably at a high-growth tech startup

  • Experience with full-cycle P2P management and P2P/T&E tools (Ramp, Tipalti or similar)

  • Strong working knowledge of ERPs: AP module, journal entries, fixed assets, and reconciliations

  • Experience with payroll software, recording payroll journal entries and reconciling payroll-related accounts

  • Solid understanding of US GAAP

  • Able to manage multiple workflows simultaneously without things falling through the cracks

  • Sharp eye for discrepancies in AP, payroll, or expense data

  • Experience preparing reconciliation schedules and flux analyses

  • Ability to quickly understand workflows end-to-end and grasp how systems integrate with each other

Nice to haves

  • Experience working in a globally distributed team and multi-entity environment

  • Experience with global creator payment management

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance; CPA or actively pursuing CPA preferred

  • Experience supporting external (Big 4) audits

Why work at Speak

  1. Join a fantastic, tight-knit team at the right time: we're growing very quickly, we've most recently raised our Series C from some of the top investors in the valley, and we've achieved product-market fit in our initial markets. You'd join at a magical time when a single person could significantly change the course of the company.

  2. Do your life's work with people you’ll love working with: we care strongly about our craft and want every person at Speak to feel like they're growing every day. We believe in the idea that working with people you both enjoy and have respect for makes everything better. We hire thoughtfully and only work with people we admire deeply.

  3. Global in nature: We're live in over 40 countries and launching in a number of new markets soon. We have dedicated offices in San Francisco, Ljubljana, Seoul, and Tokyo, and you’ll have the opportunity to talk to users in each of these regions on a regular basis as well as travel.

  4. Impact people's lives in a major way: Learning a language is one of the single most life-changing skills one can learn, and right now 99% of people never achieve their goal because the process is broken. We’re helping millions of people achieve their goals and improve their lives.

  • Manage and oversee our Speak Korea marketing teams (Brand, Growth, Partnership, and Design)

  • Communicate local product needs, working closely with CX, Engineering, Product, and Design

  • Build strong relationships with other major markets like Japan and Taiwan

  • Coach, mentor, and develop team members to achieve business objectives and ensure team motivation

jobs.title: Senior Field Marketing Specialist - Korea
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

Our mission is to reinvent the way people learn, starting with language.

Learning a language can change a life by opening doors to new cultures, careers, and communities. Two billion people around the world are actively trying to learn a language, but the best way to learn (one-on-one tutoring) is hard to access at scale and hasn’t been meaningfully improved in decades. Speak first launched in South Korea in 2019, where Speak has now become the number one language learning app, and we now serve learners across many markets and 15+ languages. Speak is one of the world’s leading AI companies, with over $150m raised in venture investment from OpenAI, Accel, Founders Fund, Khosla Ventures, and more, with a distributed team across San Francisco, Seoul, Tokyo, Taipei, and Ljubljana.

About This Role

As Speak continues expanding its presence in Korea, Speak for Business (S4B) presents a strategic opportunity to help Korea's largest enterprises develop their workforce through innovative English learning. We're partnering with some of the most prominent companies and organizations in South Korea — and we're building the marketing engine to match that ambition.

To support our next phase of enterprise growth, we're hiring a Senior Field Marketing Specialist to own Korea's field marketing function and take full accountability for enterprise pipeline contribution. This is not just an execution or support role — you'll own the annual marketing strategy, the event calendar, the partner ecosystem, and the community and nurture programs that connect marketing directly to revenue, with support from our B2B Marketing lead.

You'll co-own territory plans with Sales, partner closely with our global digital and content team to connect field activities to broader campaigns, and build the systems and programs that turn enterprise engagement into pipeline.

What you’ll be doing

You’ll work closely with the S4B Marketing Lead and cross-functional teams to lead and support key B2B marketing initiatives in South Korea, including:

Planning & Territory Strategy

  • Build annual and quarterly marketing plans tied to Korea enterprise pipeline and bookings goals, in partnership with Sales

  • Co-develop territory plans with Sales that drive enterprise customer outcomes

  • Manage and optimize the demand funnel — ensuring efficient lead flow from marketing activity through to sales progression

  • Maintain quarterly execution plans reviewed and adjusted based on performance data

  • Surface local market insights and content requirements to global teams to optimize future programs

Field Marketing & Event Calendar

  • Own the Korea B2B enterprise event calendar and budget end-to-end — from annual strategy and budget planning through individual event execution and post-event close-out

  • Develop audience-informed event briefs with clear enterprise objectives, MQL/SQL targets, messaging strategy, and documented learnings after each cycle

  • Direct vendors, agencies, and speakers — owning every decision while managing execution through others

  • Own post-event and campaign lead nurturing in HubSpot — building multi-touch workflows that activate enterprise leads immediately and move them through the funnel efficiently, while tracking ROI (ex. CPL, pipeline contribution, etc.)

Partner Marketing & Community Management

  • Build and manage a strategic enterprise partner ecosystem — HR associations, industry platforms, co-marketing partners, and thought leaders

  • Activate partner channels for joint enterprise lead generation, co-branded content, and event collaboration

  • Own community strategy across both prospect-facing and end-user-facing channels for enterprise audiences

  • Prospect-side: build and manage a community that nurtures enterprise buyers through the consideration stage — roundtables, HR/L&D forums, thought leadership events, and digital communities

  • End-user side: own the B2B Kakao channel and other engagement touchpoints with a strategy to grow enterprise user engagement and drive retention and upsell

Reporting & Optimization

  • Deliver regular insights, analysis, and reporting across all programs — event ROI, campaign performance, community metrics, and pipeline contribution

  • Build and maintain HubSpot dashboards that give Sales and leadership clear visibility into marketing's enterprise pipeline impact

  • Identify what's working, bring recommendations, and act on them

What we’re looking for

  • 6+ years of B2B marketing experience with a strong background in field marketing or demand generation, focused on enterprise accounts

  • Proactiveness; you are always looking for new ideas and ways to improve based on market research, previous event data, experience etc.

  • Strong CRM (plus if HubSpot) proficiency across workflows, segmentation, nurturing, and reporting, with a strong data-driven mindset

  • Strong project management skills and high attention to detail across multiple workstreams and cross-functional partners (like Sales)

  • Strong written and verbal Korean; working English proficiency

  • Experience managing vendors, agencies, and external partners

  • Experience in partner or co-marketing programs is a strong plus

  • Background in EdTech, HRTech, or B2B SaaS is a plus

Why work at Speak

  1. Join a fantastic, tight-knit team at the right time: we're growing very quickly, we've most recently raised our Series C from some of the top investors in the valley, and we've achieved product-market fit in our initial markets. You'd join at a magical time when a single person could significantly change the course of the company.

  2. Do your life's work with people you’ll love working with: we care strongly about our craft and want every person at Speak to feel like they're growing every day. We believe in the idea that working with people you both enjoy and have respect for makes everything better. We hire thoughtfully and only work with people we admire deeply.

  3. Global in nature: We're live in over 40 countries and launching in a number of new markets soon. We have dedicated offices in San Francisco, Ljubljana, Seoul, and Tokyo, and you’ll have the opportunity to talk to users in each of these regions on a regular basis as well as travel.

  4. Impact people's lives in a major way: Learning a language is one of the single most life-changing skills one can learn, and right now 99% of people never achieve their goal because the process is broken. We’re helping millions of people achieve their goals and improve their lives.

About this role

We’re hiring an ML Engineer, Assessments to help build best-in-class assessment systems across multiple products (Speak for Business, B2C, and new surfaces). You will work in a tight loop with our Assessment Design Lead (Content/Learning Design), Machine Learning, Product, and Engineering to turn assessment constructs and rubrics into reliable, scalable scoring + feedback systems.

This role owns the implementation, deployment, and ongoing quality of our assessment algorithms and ML systems. While there is immediate need to improve and expand production assessments, this work is also building a platform capability that can be reused across the app.

What you’ll be doing

  • Ship and own assessment ML systems end-to-end

    • Build, deploy, and maintain scoring models/pipelines (feature extraction → model training → inference → feedback generation)

    • Own monitoring, regression tests, and ongoing iteration to maintain accuracy targets

  • Define and operationalize evaluation

    • Implement validation/evaluation frameworks for assessments, including metrics, test sets, and offline/online analysis

    • Translate assessment requirements into measurable acceptance criteria and guardrails

  • Partner deeply with the Assessment Design Lead

    • Co-develop the strategy, together with the Content team, to grow assessments into a core platform at Speak

    • Work in a tight weekly loop to deliver incremental improvement

  • Drive near-term delivery across products

    • Stand up or improve summative assessments (spoken language ability) and bring them reliably to production

    • Prototype and validate formative assessment approaches to measure improvement over weeks/months

  • Support data and labeling strategy

    • Help define data needs for training/evaluation (including psychometric measurement needs)

    • Build or improve pipelines that support label collection and analysis (especially for efficacy studies)

What we’re looking for

  • Domain expertise in spoken language proficiency assessment (linguistics, applied linguistics, pedagogy, or equivalent experience)

  • Strong experience designing and running evaluation + validation for assessment/scoring systems, and tailoring approaches to a specific product use case

  • 4+ years building automatic proficiency assessment systems (or equivalent depth in closely related scoring/evaluation domains)

    • PhD is helpful but not required

  • Proven ability to ship ML models to production (not only research), including reliability, monitoring, and iteration

  • Strong generalist ML/analysis skills (statistics, Python, PyTorch/model training)

  • Ability to operate cross-functionally and communicate clearly with non-technical partners (Content/LD, PM, leadership)

Nice to have

  • Experience with speech/audio ML

  • Experience with psychometrics concepts (reliability/validity, calibration)

This role is designed to be highly collaborative with the Assessment Design Lead. Success depends on a tight loop where constructs/rubrics and model outputs co-evolve — not a sequential handoff.

  1. Join a fantastic, tight-knit team at the right time: we're growing very quickly, we've most recently raised our Series C from some of the top investors in the valley, and we've achieved product-market fit in our initial markets. You'd join at a magical time when a single person could significantly change the course of the company.

  2. Do your life's work with people you’ll love working with: we care strongly about our craft and want every person at Speak to feel like they're growing every day. We believe in the idea that working with people you both enjoy and have respect for makes everything better. We hire thoughtfully and only work with people we admire deeply.

  • Driving your team's agentic engineering transformation: constantly asking what's still being done manually, identifying slowdowns and roadblocks, and actively closing the gap

  • Setting the pace and driving velocity while articulating and setting a high quality bar

  • Collaborating closely and effectively with partner functions like Product/Design/many more to execute effectively in the AI era

  • Proactively pushing for changes to shared infrastructure, tooling, and systems that help the broader engineering org become more agentic

  • Building and maintaining a healthy, high-performing team culture

  • 4+ years of direct team management experience

  • Strong backend, systems, platform/infra, or performance background

  • Deeply technical and building faster than ever with coding agents

  • High agency but low ego

  • Strong conviction that 10x engineering output is possible with agentic tools and practices

  • Proven ability to drive velocity, hold a high quality bar, and give direct performance feedback

  • Excited about working in-person in San Francisco at least 3-4 days per week

Nice to haves

  • Background in AI-native products and systems

  • Track record of driving org-wide developer productivity or tooling initiatives

jobs.title: Bilingual English/Spanish Learning Designer (Contract)
jobs.descriptionHtml:

Our mission is to reinvent the way people learn, starting with language.

Learning a language can change a life by opening doors to new cultures, careers, and communities. We are looking for a part-time remote Bilingual English/Spanish Learning Designer (Contractor) to join Speak's content team and help create high-quality language learning materials for our LATAM users.

We are eager to work with content developers who

  • have native or near-native bilingual proficiency in Spanish and English

  • have a deep understanding of spoken fluency development in both English and Spanish and can develop, edit, or localize innovative, engaging, and pedagogically sound materials for learners.

  • have experience successfully teaching or developing learning modules/materials for learners online or in-app.

This is a part-time, fully remote contract role that requires 20 hours availability per week.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Curriculum design and lesson writing: Design learning materials (lesson scripts, activities, unit summaries) for learners at varying proficiency levels across the Spanish-English language pair. Participate in content projects from planning through writing, production, and launch.

  • Content QA across both languages: Review and quality-check content in both Spanish and English, catching errors in language accuracy, pedagogical soundness, tone, and formatting.

  • AI-assisted content production: Use AI tools to accelerate drafting and localization workflows. We value people who can guide AI output with creative judgment, shaping it into something that meets Speak's quality bar and recognizing when it needs a human touch.

  • Translation and localization: Translate and localize in-app learning and marketing content into LATAM Spanish, ensuring cultural and linguistic appropriateness.

  • Content iteration: Revise and polish content based on QA feedback, user testing results, and peer reviews.

  • Collaboration: Work remotely with a US-based team. Participate in content team syncs and discussions as needed; contribute insights about the LATAM learner market.

What We’re Looking For


Required

  • Native Spanish speaker (LATAM Spanish) with near-native English proficiency in both spoken and written communication.

  • 3+ years of professional learning design or curriculum design experience. We're looking for someone for whom learning design is an established craft, with hands-on experience designing learning experiences for a product or platform (not solely classroom instruction).

  • Experience in edtech, app-based learning, or a closely related field (e.g., digital learning platforms, game-based learning, corporate L&D with a digital delivery component).

  • Demonstrated ability to work with AI tools for content production.

  • Strong attention to detail. You'll be QA-ing content in two languages, so a careful eye for accuracy, tone, and consistency matters a lot in this role.
